chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The center of Paradise is for me and for my Household.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the center of Paradise for the Prophet and his Household?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, this hadith emphasizes the unique eschatological rank of the Ahl al-Bayt, positioning them at the spiritual and physical center of Paradise. This designation underscores their role as the inheritors of prophetic authority and the focal point of divine love, a concept deeply rooted in Shia exegesis of the Verse of Purification and the Verse of Kinship.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-315 According to the same documentation on the authority of Ali (a.s.), God’s Prophet (S) said, “
The center of Paradise is for me and the members of my Household.”
